violations.description: CROSS CONTAMINATION (5 pts): Raw meat noted being stored above food not requiring further cooking. Raw beef was noted over ready-to-eat/pre-cooked crab meat on the wire rack shelving in the walk-in cooler. Critical violation corrected by rearraning products and training on the topic. | CROSS CONTAMINATION (5 pts): Box of raw pork pieces noted stored on open box of butter on wire rack shelving in the walk-in cooler. Raw meats are never to be stored above or in a manner where they could cross contaminate pre-cooked/ready-to-eat foods. Critical violation corrected by moving food around and training on the topic. | CROSS CONTAMINATION (5 pts): Pan of raw chicken noted being stored over tubs of raw seafood on wire shelving in the walk-in cooler. Raw meats are to be stored according to final cooking temperature with the meat requiring the highest final cooking temperature always on the bottom. Raw meats should be stored from bottom to top as follows: chicken beef pork seafood and all ready-to-eat/pre-cooked foods on the very top. Critical violation corrected by rearranging the food and training on the topic. | CROSS CONTAMINATION (5 pts): Box of raw chicken noted being stored on top of box of raw beef on black rolling cart in the walk-in cooler. Raw meats are to be stored according to final cooking temperature with the meat requiring the highest final cooking temperature always on the bottom. Raw meats should be stored from bottom to top as follows: chicken beef pork seafood and all ready-to-eat/pre-cooked foods on the very top. Critical violation corrected by rearranging the food and training on the topic.

FOOD DISPLAY SERVICE AND TRANSPORT TEMP (5 pts): Hydrated noodles sitting in containers full of water noted not being held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below. *Also of note were cut leafy greens such as lettuce spinach etc. that were being stored at room temperature before service. While the current SD Food code does not specify these as TCS foods Current FDA food code does consider them TCS food. As such they should be stored under refrigeration at all times. Critical violation corrected by moving the items to a cooler and training on the topic. This was accepted because the items had very recently been placed for storage on the wire shelving unit.

HANDWASHING LAVATORIES AND SUPPLIES (3 pts): A hand drying device was noted not provided at the hand washing lavatory in the ware-washing area. Paper towels were replaced to correct the violation on the spot. | HANDWASHING LAVATORIES AND SUPPLIES (3 pts): Hand washing lavatory in kitchen noted blocked with boxes of gloves and water hose/spray nozzle. Critical violation corrected through training on the topic and removing the items that were blocking access to the hand sink.
REFUSE STORAGE (1 pts): Exterior garbage/recyclables container noted not covered with a tight fitting lid. Lids noted open.
NON FOOD CONTACT SURFACES - CLEAN (1 pts): Interior of red microwave and shelving under prep table containing cutting boards noted not clean.
EMPLOYEE PRACTICES (1 pts): Employee beverage noted stored on a prep cooler.

CROSS CONTAMINATION (5 pts): Raw beef noted stored on top of sauce bucket. Raw meats are not to be stored over foods that do not require the same final cooking temperature. Also raw beef and pork noted stored over raw seafood. Raw meats are to be stored from bottom to top as follows according to final cooking temperature requirements: chicken beef pork seafood and all ready-to-eat foods on top. Critical violation corrected by moving the products in question and education on the topic.

HANDWASHING LAVATORIES AND SUPPLIES (3 pts): The hand washing lavatory in the kitchen noted being used for other than hand washing. Dishes noted in hand sinks. Critical violation corrected by removing the items.
CONTAMINATION DURING STORAGE (2 pts): Rubber mallets not meant for food use noted in a box of potatoes. Food grade mallets should be obtained also to prevent a violation.
FLOORS WALLS CEILINGS (1 pts): Floors in the kitchen noted with missing grout in need of repair/re-grouting.

CROSS CONTAMINATION (5 pts): Raw meat noted being stored above food not to be further cooked. Raw beef noted over sesame dipping sauce. Beef was moved and education was given about the violation to correct the critical violation.

FOOD SOURCE (4 pts): Food from dented and bulging cans noted being used in the establishment. Dented and bulging cans of pineapple noted in facility. Food from dented and bulging cans has the potential to contain hazardous pathogens such as Clostridium botulinum. Cans were removed from service and education was given on the topic to correct the critical violation.
HANDWASHING LAVATORIES AND SUPPLIES (3 pts): Soap was noted not provided at the hand washing lavatory near the pop machine. Soap was replaced to correct the violation.

IN-USE UTENSILS (1 pts): Drink mix spoons noted in cup of soda water. In-use utensils such as mixing spoons ice cream scoops etc. need to be stored on a clean dry sanitizable surface if no dipper well is present in the facility.
PREMISES (1 pts): Cell phone noted on prep counter and table with clean dishes. Mops noted not hung. Mop noted in yellow mop bucket.
